The gardeners planted apple trees beside the river. Each spring they checked the soil and pruned damaged branches. Rainfall helped the roots grow through summer. The harvest supplied fresh fruit to the village market and local schools.

Rising water entered the houses during the night. Volunteers carried families to higher ground in small boats. The community centre provided dry blankets and warm meals while residents waited for the river to fall.
The damaged bridge reopened after engineers inspected the stone supports. Residents returned to repair their homes.

The steam locomotive pulled passenger carriages across the valley. Workers shovelled coal into the firebox and watched the pressure gauge. The station master announced departures while families waited on the platform for the morning train.
Operation Marigold discussed confidential shelter locations and private evacuation routes. The committee kept the register sealed and limited access to approved staff.
